henry.title: Koto Sounds: 5-Note Tunes and a New Chord
henry.intro: Hear a Japanese koto, play a 5-note tune, then learn chord number 2. (About 15 minutes.)
steps: 🎵 Watch the first 2 minutes of the koto video.
🎹 Play only black keys. Make up a tune.
🎸 Learn A minor: middle finger, G string, fret 2.
🔁 Switch C and Am, 4 strums each.
✏️ Fill in the worksheet.
links: Watch the first 2 minutes. Count the strings and the finger picks.

passage.text: 🎶 The koto is a long Japanese instrument with 13 strings. It came from China about 1,300 years ago.
passage.q: How many strings does a koto have?

passage.text: 💅 Players wear picks on 3 fingers. They move little bridges under the strings to tune it.
🎹 A lot of Japanese music uses just 5 notes. The piano's black keys come in groups of 2 and 3. That's 5 notes too!
passage.q: How many black keys in one set of 2 + 3?

passage.text: 🎸 A minor (Am) is a new chord. Minor chords sound a bit sad or dreamy. C sounds bright.

words: a hard tip for plucking strings
a set of notes in order
a chord that sounds sad or dreamy

handsOn.title: 🎹 Black-key tune + 🎸 A minor chord
steps: guides/piano-black5.svg
Find a group of 2 and a group of 3 black keys. Number them 1 to 5.
guides/piano-black5.svg
Play 1 2 3 5 3 2 1. Slow. Does it sound like Japan?
guides/piano-black5.svg
Make up your own 8-note tune on black keys only. End on 1.
guides/uke-am-chord.svg
Uke: press the G string, fret 2, with your middle finger. Strum. That's Am!
guides/uke-c-chord.svg
Strum C 4 times (ring finger, A string, fret 3).
guides/uke-am-chord.svg
Switch: Am 4 strums, C 4 strums. Count your switches with no stop.
guides/strings-compare.svg
Bonus: Guitar: pluck one string and slide your finger up. Hear it bend, like a koto!
handsOn.look: Black keys always sound good together. Am uses the G string; C uses the A string.
handsOn.q: Questions 3 to 7 come from the piano and uke.

worksheet: Koto players wear picks on ____ fingers. Circle: 3 / 10
For Am I press the ____ string with finger ____ in fret ____. Circle: G / A · 2 / 3 · 2 / 3
Am sounds: Circle: bright / sad or dreamy. C sounds: bright / sad
I switched C → Am ____ times without stopping.
henry.challenge: Play your black-key tune on the piano while someone strums Am on the uke. Do they fit? Then try it with C.

frankie.title: Black-Key Tune + Paper Dog 🎹🐶
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud: In Japan, people fold paper into animals. This is called origami. First we play a tune on the black keys, then fold a paper dog! (About 14 minutes.)
steps: 🎹 Find the 3 black keys together. Number them 1 2 3.
🎶 Play Hot Cross Buns on the black keys!
🐶 Fold a paper dog: triangle, then ears.
🔤 Sound out d-o-g. Trace, then write it (stretch!).

handsOn.title: 🎹 Black keys + 🐶 Paper dog
steps: guides/piano-black3.svg
👀 Find the group of 3 black keys. Point: 1, 2, 3.
guides/piano-black3.svg
🎶 Play Hot Cross Buns: 3 2 1 · 3 2 1 · 1 1 1 1 2 2 2 2 · 3 2 1
guides/origami-dog.svg
📄 Grown-up gives a square paper. Fold it in half to make a triangle. Point down.
guides/origami-dog.svg
👂 Fold the 2 top corners down. Those are the ears!
guides/origami-dog.svg
🔵 Put on 2 sticker eyes and a nose (or grown-up adds dots).
handsOn.look: Grown-up: it's the same tune as last week, now on black keys. Say the numbers as he plays.
